title: The Very Hungry Caterpillar
author: Eric Carle
short_summary: A tiny caterpillar hatches from an egg one Sunday morning and spends the next week eating his way through more and more food, day by day, until a giant feast of junk food gives him a stomachache. After a rest inside a cocoon, he transforms into a beautiful butterfly.
extended_summary:
One Sunday, in the light of the moon, a tiny egg lies on a leaf. On Sunday morning, the warm sun comes up and a tiny, very hungry caterpillar hatches out. He starts looking for food right away, and over the next several days eats through more fruit each day — one apple on Monday, two pears on Tuesday, three plums on Wednesday, four strawberries on Thursday, and five oranges on Friday — but he is still hungry.

On Saturday, the caterpillar eats through a huge pile of tempting but unhealthy food: chocolate cake, ice cream, a pickle, cheese, salami, a lollipop, cherry pie, sausage, a cupcake, and a slice of watermelon, and afterward he has a terrible stomachache. The next day, on Sunday, he eats through one nice green leaf, and after that he feels much better.

Now big and fat, the caterpillar builds himself a small house called a cocoon and stays inside it for more than two weeks. When he finally nibbles a hole and pushes his way out, he is no longer a caterpillar at all — he has become a beautiful butterfly, ready to fly out into the world.
